Name: Phlegon
Summary: Phlegon was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Hermas, Patrobas, and Hermes.
KeyStory: Phlegon was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Hermas, Patrobas, and Hermes.
